9666e7f7-2241-4f47-9215-725233784a5d.fullMessage:
Heavy rain may loosen soil and rocks on hillsides and road cuts across Tabuk City. Avoid steep slopes, river banks and road cuts, and use the main roads where possible. Report cracks in the ground, falling rocks, or water flowing down slopes to the CDRRMO hotline right away.
